clauses.clause_label: All Rights Reserved — no permission granted
clauses.actor_role: person obtaining a copy of the Software
clauses.scope_note: The text expressly withholds permission for the listed activities with respect to the Software, including merging it and permitting persons to whom it is furnished to do so. It does not address unrelated artifacts.

clauses.actor_role: person using, reproducing, or distributing the Software
clauses.scope_note: The Software is described as provided solely to demonstrate the author's work for a Swiggy Builder's Club Developer Program application; unauthorized use, reproduction, or distribution, in whole or in part, is expressly prohibited. This purpose statement does not itself grant permission, and the text does not define what use is authorized.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when use, reproduction, or distribution is unauthorized; the text does not specify criteria for determining authorization.

coverage_notes: The supplied text is an All Rights Reserved notice, not a grant of license rights. The express denial of permission in lines 8–11 is limited to the Software and listed activities; no permission for other activities should be inferred.
The warranty disclaimer and limitation of liability in lines 18–24 do not establish permissions or restrictions on the requested activities and are omitted.
The demonstration-purpose statement does not supply a clear permission or define authorized use.
